missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Октябрь' stays in the nominative as the subject. This is a soft masculine noun, and 'тёплый' is the agreeing masculine adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Октябрь' is the accusative direct object of 'люблю'; as an inanimate masculine noun it matches the nominative form. 'Очень' intensifies the feeling.
Strategic focus: Genitive of time. 'Октября' is the genitive after 'в начале' to mean at the start of October. 'Дожди' is the nominative plural subject of 'идут'.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of time. 'В октябре' uses the prepositional form 'октябре' after 'в' to express the month when something happens. A core time expression.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Октябрём' is the instrumental required after 'перед' to mean before October. 'Праздник' is the nominative subject of 'бывает'.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Октябрю' is the dative required after 'к' to express preparing for October. 'Заранее' adds that it is done in advance.
Strategic focus: Accusative coordination. 'Октябрь' is the accusative object joined by 'и' to 'сентябрь'. Both are inanimate masculine nouns matching the nominative form.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Октябри' is the accusative plural object of 'помним'. 'Холодные' agrees in the plural, recalling several past Octobers.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Об октябре' uses the prepositional form 'октябре' after 'об' to talk about the month. A clean model for the soft masculine prepositional ending.
Strategic focus: Nominative exclamation. 'Октябрь' stays in the nominative in this exclamation. 'Какой' and 'прекрасный' both agree in the masculine, expressing delight.
